notes.title: The April Update
notes.content:
Hello all,

March has been a crazy-hectic month, but here's the juice:

INIT. is now fully implemented with Unity 5, bringing with it some truly tasty visual support, including 4K (looks stunning). The latest Oculus DK2 SDK was a total suprise to all, and brings with it a whole host of features to the hardware and how it performs.

New development machines! There is not a program or game on this planet that can even TOUCH what we are now capable of running. This makes Light Baking and development woes a little easier to deal with ;)

New office! We've moved in to somewhere that isn't a flat! Its a miracle!

We've yet to establish an effective way of FPS control using Oculus. And while standard FPS controls work well with non-VR playmodes, they don't really agree with DK2. This is something that Unity has yet to really provide, and yet UE4 trounces with ease.

Hmm...rest assured, we're smashing it with Thor-like hammers.

Update to follow soon!

notes.title: March 9th Beta Update
notes.content:
After the recent Unity announcements at GDC, INIT is currently being ported to Unity 5, which brings with it a whole host of delicious new features and performance increases!

Directory 1, Construct 2 is now complete and in a few days, will be added to the Beta roster.

ːreallolː
